LESSON: PHONOLOGICAL AWARENESS: FLUENCY

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: ARABIC LANGUAGE
Strand: Listening and Speaking
Topic 1.4: Phonological Awareness: Fluency

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Phonological Awareness: Fluency
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How can the months of the year help us in organizing school activities?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. use appropriate emphasis and intonation in pronouncing words
2. answer direct questions on months of the year correctly
3. appreciate the value of time management in daily life
